name: Chirp-Caddy
description: Optional companion to Chirp-Headscale: Caddy with the Cloudflare DNS plugin, giving Headscale a public HTTPS address with automatic certificates (Headscale can't run behind Cloudflare's proxy or tunnel).

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Caddy's saved config (changes made from Chirp's Global Admin).

ports.name: HTTPS port
ports.description: Forward your router's 443 here (Unraid's own UI usually has 443).

variables.name: Cloudflare API token
variables.description: Zone:DNS:Edit for your zone only, for certificates.

variables.name: Admin API
variables.description: Published to the host's loopback only (see Extra Parameters).
